newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies fall 3.00-cent daily limit.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies fall 3.00-cent daily limit.

text.p: CME pork belly futures fell the 3.00-cent per lb daily limit in the July and August contracts early Wednesday in reaction to talk of lower cash belly prices Wednesday and an expected increase in hog slaughter next week, analysts said.
Talk circulated cash bellies were being bid 85 cents per lb Wednesday versus 89.00 at Tuesday's close.
Also, one analyst said USDA's upward revision in last week's hog slaughter also may have had a bearish impact on the market because it supported forecasts that hog supplies were increasing.
USDA revised last week's slaughter to 1.613 million head from 1.608 million.
At 0952 CDT, pork bellies were down 3.00 to 0.400 cent with July off the limit at 88.90.
